subject: BlueLattice co-sell + marketplace integration: staging & evidence plan
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluelattice.io>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: m.oneill@bluelattice.io, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Date: Sun, 4 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + staging plan for BlueLattice marketplace listing

Hi Rafael —

Thanks again for the intro last week. BlueLattice is excited to move to a joint co-sell and marketplace listing with Redwood. Marcus and I put together an initial staging plan (attached) showing what BlueLattice will own vs. what we need from Redwood for evidence, SKU mapping, and the co-marketing tile.

Key asks up front:
- A short list of technical evidence items Redwood can provide (SLA, private deploy docs, telemetry examples).
- A contact for billing SKU alignment and metering integration (we'll need a pairing for Azure/AWS listings).
- Availability for a 45-minute technical sync next week to confirm the sandbox flow and demo assets.

I've attached our integration-specs PDF and a first-pass evidence checklist. Let me know if the attached files should be dropped into a shared Drive folder instead.

Best,
Jenna Park
Head of Partnerships | BlueLattice
jenna.park@bluelattice.io
+1 415-555-0124

Attachments: bluelattice-integration-specs.pdf (PDF), co-sell-evidence-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)
From: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluelattice.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + staging plan for BlueLattice marketplace listing

Jenna —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers to your asks:
1) Technical evidence: We can provide an SLA summary page, a private deployment compliance snapshot (redacted), telemetry examples for SKU attribution, and a short video showing the demo flow. Marcus will lead the technical evidence pack.
2) Billing SKU alignment: Ben will be the internal lead for metering/SKU mapping and will coordinate with your billing ops contact.
3) Sync: I'm available Tue/Wed next week between 9a–1p PT. Marcus, Ben — can you join a 45-min slot?

I'll upload the evidence template to the Drive link you suggested once we lock the sync.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

----
On Sun, Aug 4, 2029 at 09:12 Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluelattice.io> wrote:
> Hi Rafael —
> 
> Thanks again for the intro last week. BlueLattice is excited to move to a joint co-sell...
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluelattice.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2029 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + staging plan for BlueLattice marketplace listing

Thanks — added a quick technical checklist inline below (high level) so BlueLattice knows what artifacts we'll produce from our side:

- SLA summary (1 page): uptime SLA, latency targets for hosted API, and Dedicated SLOs.
- Deployment evidence (redacted): VPC/private deploy summary + list of supported KMS integrations.
- Telemetry snapshot: sample events that demonstrate SKU attribution and request routing.
- Demo video (3–4 minutes): show a co-browsed demo on our sandbox listing, including fallback to smaller quantized model when needed.

Questions for BlueLattice before sync:
1) Which cloud(s) do you plan to list on first (AWS, GCP, Azure)?
2) Will BlueLattice require a single bundled SKU, or separate SKUs per cloud/offer?
3) Any security questionnaires already completed we can reuse?

Propose Tue 6 Aug 2029 at 10:00 AM PT for the 45-min tech + ops sync. Rafael / Ben — please confirm. Jenna — if that time doesn't work, share alternatives.

—Marcus
Senior Manager, Technical Alliances | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluelattice.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus O'Neill <m.oneill@bluelattice.io>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2029 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + staging plan for BlueLattice marketplace listing

Thanks Marcus — good checklist. Answers inline: 
1) Initial listing: AWS first, then Azure within the quarter.
2) We prefer separate SKUs per cloud to simplify marketplace billing and co-sell attribution (AWS/Marketplace private offers, Azure Managed Offer).
3) We completed a SOC2 lite questionnaire for a previous partner and will attach the redacted PDF to the Drive; you may be able to reuse a few sections.

Tue 6 Aug at 10:00 AM PT works for our team. Marcus O'Neill (cc'd) will join for the technical pieces — he owns the integration work at BlueLattice.

Will drop the redacted SOC2 into your Drive link and share our billing contact prior to the sync.

Best,
Jenna
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluelattice.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 6 Aug 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + staging plan for BlueLattice marketplace listing

Great sync today — notes below and next steps (summarized):

Meeting summary (6 Aug 2029, 10:00 AM PT):
- Confirmed initial cloud: AWS (private offers) with Azure to follow.
- SKU approach: separate SKUs per cloud; Redwood to propose SKU IDs and metering units for review.
- Evidence handoff: BlueLattice to drop redacted SOC2 + integration checklist in Drive by EOD Thu 8 Aug. Redwood to provide SLA page and telemetry sample by Fri 9 Aug.
- Technical sandbox: BlueLattice will receive a sandbox API key and a short demo VM image for validation.

Action items:
- ben_carter: create SKU proposal + metering mapping (due 2029-08-09) [attachment: sku-mapping-proposal.xlsx stub].
- marcus_lin: assemble telemetry sample and SLA draft (due 2029-08-09).
- jpark (BlueLattice): upload redacted SOC2 and billing contact (due 2029-08-08).
- rafael_mendes: coordinate co-sell collateral with GTM once SKUs are locked.

Attachments referenced: sku-mapping-proposal.xlsx (XLSX stub), meeting-recording-link (internal).

I'll follow up with the SKU file in a separate email thread and create a HubSpot deal record for BL-4521.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
